AUTODNS_CONTEXT.title: AUTODNS_CONTEXT
AUTODNS_CONTEXT.description: API context (4 for production, 1 for testing. Defaults to 4)

AUTODNS_ENDPOINT.title: AUTODNS_ENDPOINT
AUTODNS_ENDPOINT.description: API endpoint URL, defaults to https://api.autodns.com/v1/

AUTODNS_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: AUTODNS_POLLING_INTERVAL
AUTODNS_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)

AUTODNS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: AUTODNS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
AUTODNS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 120)

AUTODNS_TTL.title: AUTODNS_TTL
AUTODNS_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 600)
